Reputation Feed v0.12 core dependencies:
- ooRexx 5.3.0 (validated with r13196 Internal Test Version supplied by The Architect)
- Alchemy Objects v0.8 (`AlchemyObject.cls`, `AlchemyAdoption.cls`)
  package SHA-256 7683ed56ea99097226ea2f13f73305fb49919ba2ec822df2253ccfff59c6c073
- ooRexx Crypto v0.1 (`crypto.cls`)
  package SHA-256 3eab23b5138cba889eb11ea5b93747eb14fca8da0fd4ac936a70174349ae8f3a
- `json.cls` from the validated ooRexx 5.3.0 installation

Core independence:
- Reputation Feed remains independent of HardWorld, Legal Effect, Queue Fabric, NoSQLServer, Shannon, Institutional Policy, Reputation Effect, Interaction Event, Structured Utterance, any network SDK, and any LLM implementation.
- Event hypotheses are acquisition/corroboration evidence only. Feed does not create authoritative ReputationEvent objects or reputational dispositions.
- Source authentication, assertion ancestry and interaction assessments are evidence axes only; none establishes assertion truth or a universal source trust score.
- `ReputationFeedPolicySet` owns Feed rule meaning; Institutional Policy may select/deploy an exact set but does not reinterpret its semantics.

Optional integration dependencies:
- ooRexx Logging v0.5 for optional structured decision-trace delivery; Feed does not own logging rule/target/scope policy
  package SHA-256 31f4b3243f4a1f046f07bd41d7810509e8ef682f6850c02d52ab852458ed53fa
- Institutional Policy v0.6 for publication authority, lifecycle, deployment topology and bounded progressive rollout
  package SHA-256 179682880c0f7d221114bfc648fab4e9f678153640d850ed1c3944c478eb6ae3
- Queue Fabric v0.9-dev4 for rich object-graph delivery/persistence
  package SHA-256 9c1487f8dc878ae21a19e8fc8a139c801a80a97acd2c6575635003e6f8069898
- Reputation Effect API 0.2 for Feed -> Effect and governed promotion bridges
  package SHA-256 f3778c9114b97ec25fbd146d640db9ad25ee72dec8b5e6c6cdebf06261957b63
